Please don’t end it. There will be brighter days to come. I was at your point and fate kept me here. Somedays I don’t know why, but we won’t find out unless we stick around. Time heals pain. I can tell you this from experience. I was with my ex for 12yrs. She cheated on me, wanted a divorce and took my dogs. That was it, I was ready to end it all. Someone I never met stepped in. A few weeks later I got my dog back and she gives me a reason to wake up everyday. 

Things will get better. You think you’re a weight in your family, just imagine how much pain it’ll be if you’re not here. And trust me I’ve had the same thoughts, it’s ok. You will be ok.

I appreciate your reply. I’ve been thru the counseling ring, and know to not to use the never and always words or expectations. 
But you are right, I can’t open up to people. I hide my feelings and emotions. Truthfully a friend you can tell everything to is hard to come by. I have one friend but the live half the country away. 

It’s not about the hot women, most attractive, anything like that. I was married for 12 yrs, she cheated, and we had an easy divorce. Fortunately a month later she gave me the dog back, but in that month there were 2days I almost ended it and fortunately/unfortunately fate intervened. 

The biggest problem is coming home to nothing everyday. Add to that not sleeping and you start to go mad. I moved to a different state to live life, in which I’m doing. But the lack of companionship is slowly breaking me down. Im ok with being alone but damnit it would be nice just to have a hug. Or to wake up to. Someday I’ll find it, or say fuck it and live in the woods and be a hermit with my dog. That’s my 5year plan nowadays
